placements.title: The pipeline derives its own identity when none is supplied
placements.frame: Does the expression specify or exercise how the pipeline produces an id/slug from memory content in the absence of an explicit id — via LLM id-generation, deterministic slugify fallback, or the resulting commit — and what does that reveal about the pipeline's fallback contract?
placements.why: The segment states a recurring pipeline requirement — when no explicit id field is submitted, the system must derive a slug either through an LLM id-gen call or a deterministic slugify fallback, then commit the file — this is a subject future test envelopes on this repo will keep exercising (different content, different fallback paths, different commit outcomes), not a one-time fact. No existing narrative leaf covers id/slug-generation behavior (structure is empty), so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata rather than left as a bare fact.
